## Summary

Prepare palette artwork while loading the supplied SWF. This is the native-cache slice after merged #55; actual palette/stat components follow separately.

```text
supplied SWF
  → retained clip poses
  → 45 palette rasters
      backgrounds / tabs / scrollbar / row variants
  → isolated browser gallery
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The creator cache supplies its existing 49 controls/rings but no palette states.
  **After:** Add 45 palette entries with retained indicator child frames, separate backgrounds, omitted dynamic text and body cost-circle variants. Original control keys remain independently checked.
- Native browser checks require all 45 entries to contain ink; verify exact normal/hover/selected/locked row colours, indicator/body variants, enabled states and clamped tab poses. The existing 49 native-control raster checks still pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 493 rule/parser tests (6,091 assertions), production build and all five targeted synthetic/mock/native browser cases pass (39.4s, no skips). Supplied-SWF loading and existing real controls are exercised. Native cache gallery visually inspected.
- No media/generated data changes. Font-ID text selection, full-size previews and actual palette/stat wiring remain separate work; this cache does not establish screen parity.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the unused palette cache entries and fixture coverage.

**Blast Radius:** assets

Adds raster preparation to supplied-SWF loading. Mock assets retain their existing path.

## Summary

Allow upcoming creator text fields to choose their authored embedded font. This is the text API slice after #56.

```text
explicit embedded font ID → exact font
missing/omitted ID → existing name-prefix fallback
known/missing glyph → advance + optional letter spacing
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** Name-prefix lookup cannot distinguish regular Arial131 from bold Arial142; both source fonts have the same name, and the palette cost field requires142.
  **After:** The optional ID selects the requested glyphs and advances while unknown IDs preserve existing fallback behavior.
- Three synthetic-vector regressions cover font identity, legacy/missing-ID fallback and spacing across known/missing glyphs. Against the old method they yield one pass/two failures; the corrected method passes formatting, TypeScript and all 496 rule/parser tests (6,102 assertions).
- Current runtime callers still use the unchanged four-argument defaults. Actual text components and native/browser typography checks follow separately; no affected browser flow changes in this slice. No original font outlines, media or generated data are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the unused optional parameters.

**Blast Radius:** text

Future creator text consumers gain exact font identity; existing callers retain prefix selection.

## Summary

Add the creator text component before palette/stat integration. This is the component slice after #57.

```text
imported field metadata
  → paragraph lines and numerical advances
  → embedded glyph SVG or mock system glyphs
  → aligned/clipped field + one accessible text alternative
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** Numeric fields and exact-font API have no reusable creator text renderer.
  **After:** The component consumes field alignment, ascent, line height, alpha, wrapping, bounds and embedded font identity.
- Native/mock browser cases check centered/right text, ascent-derived placement, source opacity, four paragraph lines at 0/12/24/36px, the 15.25px cost clip, accessible text and owned React-root cleanup. Native cost glyphs match explicit Arial142 and differ from prefix-selected Arial131; mock positions follow imported advances.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 496 rule/parser tests (6,102 assertions), production build and all four new text/existing control-component browser cases pass (24.9s, no skips). Both captures visually inspected. The initial test-discovery JSON import issue was fixed in the test harness using file reads; production data loading is unchanged.
- React check: render-derived layout, no effects/listeners/state, decorative images hidden with one accessible text alternative, StrictMode fixture/root cleanup. No original glyph outlines or media committed.
- Actual palette/stat wiring and synchronized Flash comparison follow separately. Mock contours/baselines, kerning and complete text layout remain approximate/unverified.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Remove the unused component, scoped styles and isolated fixture to revert.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Future creator components consume it; current game screens have no new text-component caller.

## Summary

Allow upcoming creator text fields to choose their authored embedded font. This is the text API slice after merged #56.

```text
explicit embedded font ID → exact font
missing/omitted ID → existing name-prefix fallback
known/missing glyph → advance + optional letter spacing
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** Name-prefix lookup cannot distinguish regular Arial131 from bold Arial142; both source fonts have the same name, and the palette cost field requires142.
  **After:** The optional ID selects the requested glyphs and advances while unknown IDs preserve existing fallback behavior.
- Three synthetic-vector regressions cover font identity, legacy/missing-ID fallback and spacing across known/missing glyphs. Against the old method they yield one pass/two failures; the corrected method passes formatting, TypeScript and all 496 rule/parser tests (6,102 assertions).
- Current runtime callers still use the unchanged four-argument defaults. Actual text components and native/browser typography checks follow separately; no affected browser flow changes in this slice. No original font outlines, media or generated data are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the unused optional parameters.

**Blast Radius:** text

Future creator text consumers gain exact font identity; existing callers retain prefix selection.
